author: Jacob A. Riis
title: How the Other Half Lives: Studies Among the Tenements of New York
edition: New York: Charles Scribner’s Sons, 1890. Project Gutenberg ebook 45502 transcription of the Scribner’s text, whose title page (1890) and copyright leaf (“Copyright, 1890, by Charles Scribner’s Sons”; Trow’s Printing and Bookbinding Company) are transcribed; PG records that it was produced from Internet Archive page images; printing otherwise undated. Paragraph boundaries, spelling, punctuation and underscore emphasis markers are retained; prose line wrapping is joined with spaces. Illustration captions that fall between selected paragraphs are omitted. Riis’s photographs are not reproduced. The library text runs from Riis's Preface and the Lowell epigraph through the Introduction, Chapters I–XXV and the statistical Appendix; the title page, contents, list of illustrations, every illustration caption and the transcriber's note are omitted. Riis's footnotes keep the transcription's bracketed form (“[Footnote 4: …]”) as their own blocks where the file places them, with their numbered callouts; tables keep the transcription's line layout as preformatted blocks.

rights.basis: The transcribed title page and copyright leaf identify the 1890 Charles Scribner’s Sons text; published before 1931, its US copyright term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg identifies ebook 45502 as public domain in the USA.
